one_line: Major AI infrastructure investments face financial and political headwinds as companies navigate market corrections and regulatory pushback.

themes.title: Funding rounds and market sell-offs
themes.text: OpenAI closed $11 billion in funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation, while Anthropic pressed forward with November IPO plans amid a global tech sell-off and cooling token spend. Overall, Wall Street lost $5.7 trillion as investors grappled with AI spending returns.

stories.headline: Anthropic presses on with November IPO plans despite global AI stock sell-off
OpenAI closes $11 billion in funding at $1.25 trillion valuation
Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
Wall Street grapples with $5.7 trillion rout as AI bets unwind

themes.title: Data center pushback and infrastructure changes
themes.text: Voters passed 40 out of 41 ballot measures restricting data center development during U.S. midterms, prompting OpenAI to end NDAs with officials and pay full electricity costs. Meanwhile, Google acquired a Wyoming data center site previously developed by Crusoe.

stories.headline: U.S. midterm elections bring voter backlash and new restrictions for AI data centers
OpenAI changes data center policies after midterm voter pushback
Google acquires southeast Wyoming data center site from Crusoe

themes.title: Corporate restructuring and hardware shifts
themes.text: Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to roughly 60,000 employees as AI spending increased and ended an Oracle AI cloud rental agreement due to aging Nvidia GPUs. Nasscom warned that AI coding automation could disrupt tech hiring for graduates.

stories.headline: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI spending grows
Microsoft ends Oracle AI cloud rental as older Nvidia GPUs become obsolete
Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warns AI may impact tech jobs for graduates

themes.title: New AI models and research results
themes.text: Physical Superintelligence used an internal Anthropic model to prove the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, and Meta added Active Memory and Active Focus features to its models.

stories.headline: Physical Superintelligence AI system proves Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture
Ethan Mollick shares Anthropic data on AI impact across scientific fields
Meta brings Active Memory and Active Focus to Muse and Meta AI
